title: Serum potassium curvature does not improve cross-cycle grip-strength prediction beyond routine measures
abstract: In complete-case NHANES adults aged20+, adding squared serum potassium to a demographic,anthropometric,routine-chemistry,linear-potassium and conventional potassium-category baseline changed target MSE by a reduction of -0.000609 kg² (95% stratified-PSU source-refit interval -0.275 to 0.143). Survey-weighted improvement was 0.218 kg² (-0.612 to 0.614). Neither confirms incremental prediction; validation is across distinct NHANES cycles,not an independent measurement system.
